Tour Name: Champagne from Paris: Cellars, Villages & Reims
Short Description: Taste Champagne at Leclerc Briant, explore Hautvillers, and visit Reims Cathedral on a day trip from Paris.
Full Description:
Start your day in Épernay with a Champagne tasting at Leclerc Briant, then visit either the Moët & Chandon or Perrier-Jouët boutique. In Hautvillers, visit the abbey church where Dom Pérignon is buried and hear about his role in Champagne’s history. Back in Épernay, take a guided walk along the Avenue de Champagne before lunch. In Reims, visit the cathedral where French kings were crowned, then stop at the Veuve Clicquot and Ruinart boutiques.

We’ll pick you up from your hotel in Paris and drop you off there after the tour. Groups of 3–4 travel in a comfortable car, and groups of 4–7 travel in a premium Mercedes-Benz V-Class minivan. For groups of four, either vehicle may be used.

If you’d prefer to visit a different Champagne house, we can book it for you, subject to availability. We’ll confirm the visit and any price difference with you before booking.
Itinerary:
07:45 — Hotel pickup and departure from Paris.
10:00–11:30 — Visit and tasting at Leclerc Briant in Épernay. The tasting is included.
11:30–12:00 — Visit either the Moët & Chandon or Perrier-Jouët boutique. Optional tasting at your own expense.
12:00–12:30 — Guided visit to Hautvillers, including the abbey church and the story of Dom Pérignon.
12:30–13:00 — Guided walk along the Avenue de Champagne.
13:00–14:00 — Free time for lunch in Épernay.
14:00–14:30 — Drive to Reims.
14:30–15:00 — Guided visit to Reims Cathedral.
15:00–16:30 — Visit the Veuve Clicquot and Ruinart boutiques. Optional tastings at your own expense.
16:45–19:15 — Return to Paris and drop-off at your hotel.
What's Included:
Champagne tasting at Leclerc Briant
Guided visits to Hautvillers and Reims Cathedral
Guided walk along the Avenue de Champagne
Hotel pickup and drop-off in Paris
A guide throughout the day
Drinking water on board
What's Not Included: Lunch, optional boutique tastings, and personal purchases.
Additional Information: If Leclerc Briant is unavailable on your chosen date, we’ll suggest another Champagne house and confirm the change with you in advance.

Tour Name: Rouen & Étretat Day Trip from Paris
Short Description: Explore Rouen’s medieval streets and see Étretat’s white cliffs and sea arches on a day trip from Paris.
Full Description: Spend the morning in Rouen, walking past half-timbered houses, the Gros-Horloge astronomical clock, and the cathedral that Claude Monet painted in different light. Stop at Place du Vieux-Marché, where Joan of Arc was executed, then take a break for lunch in the old town. In the afternoon, head to Étretat to see its white chalk cliffs and natural sea arches. Take a walk along the seafront and, weather permitting, follow a coastal path to a viewpoint above the bay. We’ll pick you up from your hotel in Paris and drop you off there after the tour. Groups of 3–4 travel in a comfortable car, and groups of 4–7 travel in a premium Mercedes-Benz V-Class minivan. Either vehicle may be used for groups of four.

Tour Name: Private Loire Valley Tour: Three Châteaux in One Day
Short Description: Visit Chambord, Chenonceau and Amboise on a private day trip from Paris to the Loire Valley.
Full Description: Visit three Loire Valley châteaux in one day. Start at Chambord, where you can climb the double-helix staircase and see the towers and chimneys from the rooftop terraces.
